Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with evidence for severe insulin resistance or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance must meet all of the following criteria: Suspected severe insulin resistance, or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance, as evidenced by one or more of the following: Hyperinsulinemia (i.e. fasting insulin >30microU/mL), High insulin requirement (> 2 units per kg per day or > 200 units total per day), Phenotypic features suggesting a defect in glucose/lipid metabolism: Acanthosis nigricans, Lipodystrophy/abnormal fat distribution, Xanthomata, Fatty liver, Known or suspected mutations of the insulin receptor gene, Known or suspected autoantibodies to the insulin receptor
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has metastatic breast cancer with a PIK3CA mutation, but there is no mention of hyperinsulinemia, high insulin requirements, phenotypic features of glucose/lipid metabolism defects, or insulin receptor gene mutations/autoantibodies.
The patient is 47 years old, which satisfies the age requirement.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Ability of subject or Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or their legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Family members of patients, above (either affected or unaffected) must meet all of the following criteria: Biological relatives of patients in category (1) in whom a genetic cause of insulin resistance is known or suspected
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a family history of breast cancer (maternal aunt), but there is no mention of a genetic cause of insulin resistance in the family.
The patient is 47 years old, which satisfies the age requirement.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Ability of subject (and/or legal guardian, for minor subjects) to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed assent/consent document
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or their legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 must meet all of the following criteria: Ability of subject (and/or legal guardian, for minor subjects) to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed assent/consent document. In good general health with no known active medical conditions as evidenced by medical history. Age >= 12 years
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has metastatic breast cancer, which is an active medical condition, and is not in good general health.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2. Subjects from Cohort 1 may be included in Cohort 2 if they meet the following ADDITIONAL inclusion criteria: Fasting glucose <100 mg/dL, HbA1c <5.7%, Fasting triglycerides <150 mg/dL, Fasting insulin <30 mcU/mL, BMI <27 kg/m2 or <90th percentile for age/sex (whichever is lower)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not a healthy control subject and does not meet the criteria for Cohort 1 or 2.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with evidence for insulin resistance or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance --none
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient does not have evidence of insulin resistance or related disorders.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is currently receiving prescription medications (Fulvestrant and Palbociclib), which are not explicitly listed as exceptions.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's use of drugs or supplements affecting glucose/lipid metabolism in the past 2 months.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: History of diabetes or abnormal glucose tolerance
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of a history of diabetes or abnormal glucose tolerance.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Psychiatric or cognitive disorder that will, in the opinion of the investigators, limit the subject's ability to provide informed consent/assent, or to comply with study procedures
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has provided written informed consent, indicating no such disorder is present.
The patient is not pregnant or lactating.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2. Subjects from Cohort 1 may NOT be included in Cohort 2 if they have any of the following ADDITIONAL exclusion criteria: Abnormal screening labs, including the following: ALT or AST more than 1.5 times the upper limit of normal, Glycosuria, Clinically significant anemia, Low eGFR (<60 mL/min/1.73m2), Any other abnormality that, in the opinion of the investigator, will increase risk to the subject from participation, or interfere with interpretation of study data
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not a healthy control subject and does not meet the criteria for Cohort 1 or 2.
